DraftKings, Kalshi, international Polymarket and Polymarket US are comparison targets only. Their data cannot enter a model’s features, calibration, blends, fallback, tuning or selection. Inputs from unnamed or unprovable bookmakers are ineligible. The displayed ranking uses 30% of the 2024 score and 70% of the 2025 score. The 2026 test receives zero selection weight. Against the spread and game totals

Each model faces the same posted line from a permitted book on every game. The two-hour policy uses the lower median of the named books’ lines, including overtime. The grades retain cover, push and loss for spreads and over, push and under for totals.

All spread and total candidatesIdentical-line sportsbook comparison on nonpush outcomes

Margin thresholds, exact scores and inclusive buckets

Team margin is averaged over the two orientations of every game. An 11-point win and a win by at least 11 settle under different conditions.

Which other bookmakers supply model inputs?

The feature pipeline admits explicitly identified, permitted bookmakers from The Odds API. Coverage depends on the product, decision time and contract match. The full-season score includes each registered fallback when a market input is unavailable. Missing input is kept distinct from a neutral price.

How often did a model use an allowed price?

The registered two-hour policy needs at least two permitted books for each product. A qualifying source image and native price must already exist at the decision time, with a maximum native age of six hours. When those conditions fail, that target uses the football forecast. The November 16 source at 20:58 UTC found permitted prices for 14 upcoming games. Of those 14, only the Chargers–Ravens prices would still satisfy the six-hour freshness limit at the scheduled two-hour cutoff. Three qualifying books on each of the three products are available for 285/285 in 2024, 285/285 in 2025, 149/149 in 2026. The full test retains every completed fixture.

Live price and play-clock coverage

Both the native bookmaker timestamp and source observation must fall inside actual play. Finding a quote during a game establishes live coverage. A pre/post price change at a possession or quarter boundary additionally needs the same contract on both sides of that event.

Phase and boundary coverage at 60 and 300 seconds

The acquisition used 3,139 requests and 94,119 plan credits. It also recovered 235,585 historical player-prop pairs. Those props and live prices remain research inputs outside the scored two-hour recipes. The 300-second audit found before-and-after prices on the same contract in 45, 37 and 17 games in 2024, 2025 and 2026. The 60-second window qualified zero in all three seasons. Player-prop coverage · Acquisition by stage

The feature set names BetMGM, BetOnline, BetRivers, BetUS, Bovada, Fanatics, FanDuel, LowVig, MyBookie and Caesars (William Hill US). The richer model adds named-book differences, dispersion, price age, number of books and two-sided probabilities to the market location. Each fallback uses the market-free NFL scoring-form model. A separate 20-book challenger also admits Bally Bet, BetAnySports, betPARX, BetWhale, Courtside, ESPN BET, Fliff, Hard Rock Bet, Pinnacle and ReBet when dated evidence qualifies. Book identities do not imply independent trading desks.

How do the four comparison venues perform?

Choose a benchmark and read the model and venue columns together. Each pair uses the same games, quote clock, contract and settlement. A missing comparable price can reduce this sample below the calendar total. These scores have no role in model selection.

Compare venues side by side on identical contracts

Each row in a selected joint panel has the same matching game and payout IDs. If the source evidence covers consecutive sets of different games, the separate venue tables above keep those samples distinct.

Matched fixtures and payout definitions

Lower Brier and log loss indicate more accurate probabilities. Fractional settlements and refunded outcomes follow the named product’s rules. Executable returns require tradable depth, fees and an executable price.

Circa five-pick cards

The official contest line defines the cover, push or loss. Each eligible policy ranks the two sides by P(cover) + 0.5 × P(push) and selects five distinct games. A win scores one contest point and a push scores one half. Official sheet times and model issue times control eligibility.

Retain the incumbent and track the validation nominee

N124 long scoring form earned 46.75 points per 90 selections under the registered validation weighting. N123 calibrated cover direction and pushes earned 46.40 and leads under equal-season weights. The weekly difference is +0.019 points, with a paired 95% interval from −0.514 to +0.519. The nominee leads in 25 of 36 leave-one-week-out tests. These are reconstructions of 46 official worksheets. Verified contest entries total zero.
